address: 49 Dean Street, Soho, London, W1D 5BG, United Kingdom
bio: This historic Soho watering hole, once a favourite haunt of writers and artists such as Dylan Thomas, Brendan Behan and Francis Bacon, has only seven tables in its oxblood and wood-panelled upstairs restaurant. It’s run in a bohemian style and offers traditional, honest cooking with integrity and flavour....
